# Winning Through the Cycle


-


10/20/26


Active management is the key to insurance cycle success, rather than broad-based market reactions, says John Sakakeeny, Chief Underwriting Officer of Global Programs at SiriusPoint.


In today’s edition of Program Manager, published on day two of the Target Markets Program Administrators Association Annual Summit, John covers growth and profitability, keeping underwriting discipline when times look tough, and assessing opportunities by sub-market.


*“The most successful program carriers are those that view cycle management as a continuous process rather than a periodic exercise. Market conditions will always change.”*
